LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MuGirlBloodline.label: [Raven] Snow-Cow Bloodline (Dominant)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MuGirlBloodline.description:
A sturdy bloodline from the Snow-Cow girl (Mugirl). It makes the skin incredibly hard and resilient to blows, and even allows the bearer to produce special nutritious milk.

Stat bonuses:
- Armor +60%
- Heat armor +80%
- Damage taken -15%
- Melee damage +15%
